classification.all_map: Road + ATV + Flying living on-map vehicles in current city.
classification.civilian: Excludes player, alien and ORG_MEGAPOL owners.
classification.events: Endpoint-visible transitions; coarse mode can miss sub-frame journeys or vehicles. Event counters are not complete dispatch throughput.
classification.initial_ground: Road/ATV cohort present on the map at the initial checkpoint, retaining handles to distinguish movement, parking and observed death.
classification.max_road_stopped_ticks: Largest current mission roadStoppedTicks among on-map ground vehicles at a checkpoint.
classification.parked: Living current-city vehicles with currentBuilding, including player vehicles.
classification.police: All ORG_MEGAPOL on-map vehicles, including generated traffic.
classification.road_stopped_12000: Count of on-map ground vehicles with current mission roadStoppedTicks >=12000.
classification.stationary_12000: Mission-bearing ground vehicle with no net displacement during consecutive observations accumulating 12000 ticks. In coarse mode this cannot prove continuous immobility inside a frame; fine mode observes each six-tick step.

limitations: Individual run observations are not independent replicated estimates or statistical significance tests.
Identical saved input and RNG state need not produce identical prefixes; separate traces are retained.
Unchecked turbo runs continue through any canTurbo=false frames and report the count. Strict eligible-hour checks every frame. Neither mode supplies rendered UI evidence by itself.
Position stationarity and current-mission stopped counters measure different behavior; preserve both. High density alone does not demonstrate healthy flow.
Mission stopped counters are sampled at census checkpoints; the maximum is a sampled maximum, not a continuous-time upper bound.
Results apply to source commit and frozen binary above. Historical datasets remain unchanged; no blanket parity claim is made for other material heads or custom saves.

method.coarse: Actual updateTurbo at 43200 ticks/frame; position observed and census emitted at each frame endpoint.
method.dispatch: Traffic batch at messages in FileLevel 3 log, independent of sampled map entries.
method.fine: Actual update(6); position observed every six ticks; census emitted every 12000 ticks plus final endpoint.
method.means: Equal-weight population checkpoints; fine-step runs include an irregular final checkpoint.
method.resume: Load saved GameState and initState; no startGame, reseeding, mission resets or observer vehicle deletion.
